observations: Three photos show the same PS4 game case for NBA 2K20.
The case is blue with the PS4 logo at the top.
The cover art features Anthony Davis with a yellow sticker on his head in all photos.
The ESRB rating 'E' for Everyone is visible on the bottom left of the cover.
A silver holographic sticker with 'N872204530' is visible on the right side of the cover in all photos.
The case appears to be in good physical condition with no visible cracks or damage.
The background includes a wall with a 'Prezin' sign and a red couch, suggesting a retail or gaming store setting.
The watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI PREZIN GADGETS' is overlaid on all photos.

claims.claim: NBA 2K20 is a highly popular basketball simulation video game developed by Visual Concepts
claims.evidence: The game title and PS4 branding are visible, but the developer 'Visual Concepts' is not readable on the cover. The claim about popularity is subjective and not verifiable from photos.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The game disc may be damaged or missing.
risks.proof: A photo of the game disc inside the case, showing no scratches or damage.

Photo of the game disc inside the case.
Photo of the game disc showing the region code or console compatibility.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
